column1: # Partition table — Unified Golden Path ESP32 (4 MB flash)
# A/B layout (OTA) for safe over-the-air updates:
# The OTA process writes new firmware to the inactive slot and validates its
# integrity with SHA-256 (esp_ota_end); only then updates otadata to point
# SIGNATURE: firmware signature verification is currently performed in the
# cloud with AWS Signer before distribution. ON-DEVICE signature verification
# (Secure Boot v2 / CONFIG_SECURE_SIGNED_APP_*) is a Block 3 deliverable.
# health-check) is activated in Block 3; that is why
# CONFIG_BOOTLOADER_APP_ROLLBACK_ENABLE is commented out in sdkconfig.defaults.
# There is currently no automatic rollback to the previous slot on boot failure.
#   otadata   : 0x00F000 →   8 KB  (A/B metadata: which slot to boot)
# Total used: ~3.375 MiB of 4 MiB. The remainder is unallocated.
